class.name: SteamAudioPlayer
class.brief_description: This player's transform is used as the audio source transform in the SteamAudio simulation.
class.description: Processes an inner [AudioStream] through Steam Audio's direct sound, spatialization, reflection, and pathing effects. The inherited [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.panning_strength] is always forced to 0; use [member ambisonics] to spatialize the direct sound. At runtime the configured stream is wrapped in a [SteamAudioStream]. Use [method play_stream] instead of assigning [member AudioStreamPlayer.stream] when replacing a playing sound.

method.name: get_inner_stream
method.description: Returns the user-provided [AudioStream] wrapped by the internal [SteamAudioStream].

method.name: get_inner_stream_playback
method.description: Returns the current inner [AudioStreamPlayback], or [code]null[/code] while the player is not playing.

method.name: play_stream
method.description: Replaces the inner stream and starts it at [param from_offset] while preserving Steam Audio processing. Stops and restarts the player if it is already playing. [param volume_db] and [param pitch_scale] are currently ignored; set the inherited player properties instead.

members.member: Enables frequency-dependent attenuation through air over the source-to-listener distance.

Exponential decay coefficient for high frequencies. Used only when [member air_absorption] is enabled and [member air_absorption_model] is Exponential. Higher values attenuate this band faster with distance.

Exponential decay coefficient for low frequencies. Used only when [member air_absorption] is enabled and [member air_absorption_model] is Exponential. Higher values attenuate this band faster with distance.

Exponential decay coefficient for middle frequencies. Used only when [member air_absorption] is enabled and [member air_absorption_model] is Exponential. Higher values attenuate this band faster with distance.
Air-absorption model. Default derives physical decay rates from standard air properties. Exponential uses the low, middle, and high coefficients configured on this player.

Spatializes the dry direct sound relative to the listener using ambisonic encoding and binaural HRTF decoding. When disabled, the processed inner stream is mixed without Steam Audio directional spatialization. Godot panning remains disabled in both modes.

Ambisonic order used for direct spatialization and reflection rendering. Higher orders improve directional detail but use more channels and processing. Values are clamped to the maximum allocated when [SteamAudioConfig] initialized.
Enables Steam Audio inverse-distance attenuation. Enabling it disables Godot's inherited attenuation model; disable this option before using Godot attenuation again.
Attenuates sound according to the source's orientation and weighted dipole pattern. The pattern is aligned with the source's local -Z forward axis.
Sharpness of the dipole directivity pattern. Higher values focus emission into narrower directions. Used only when [member directivity] is enabled.
Blend between omnidirectional emission at 0, a cardioid pattern at 0.5, and a pure dipole at 1. Used only when [member directivity] is enabled.
The maximum distance from the listener at which reflection simulation and its wet mix are enabled for this audio source.

See [url=https://valvesoftware.github.io/steam-audio/doc/capi/simulation.html#_CPPv4N27IPLDistanceAttenuationModel11minDistanceE]IPLDistanceAttenuationModel.minDistance[/url], and note the distance attenuation type in godot-steam-audio is always [code]IPL_DISTANCEATTENUATIONTYPE_INVERSEDISTANCE[/code].
If validation is on and a baked path is blocked by dynamic geometry, search for an alternate path.

Gain applied to the pathing wet mix. Baked pathing is used automatically when pathing data is present. For occluded sources, pathing is muted when a visible source/listener probe neighborhood cannot be guaranteed, including missing probe metadata, no visible influences, or eight or more occluded influences in the selected batch.
Ambisonic order used to spatialize pathing, clamped to the simulator's allocated maximum. Audio uses the order of the completed simulation, not a setting changed while that simulation was running.
Re-test baked paths against dynamic geometry (doors, movers).
Whether Steam Audio occlusion and transmission is enabled. Direct occlusion is ray-traced at runtime; the Steam Audio SDK does not provide baked direct occlusion data.
See [url=https://valvesoftware.github.io/steam-audio/doc/capi/simulation.html#_CPPv4N19IPLSimulationInputs15occlusionRadiusE]IPLSimulationInputs.occlusionRadius[/url].
Number of samples used for volumetric occlusion. Higher values make partial occlusion smoother at greater simulation cost. Clamped at startup to [member SteamAudioConfig.max_occlusion_samples].

Enables the reflected wet signal. Automatically uses listener-centric baked reverb when a usable reflection-bearing probe neighborhood is available, and otherwise falls back to real-time source reflections.
Number of rays used to estimate sound transmitted through occluding geometry. Higher values improve stability at increased simulation cost. Used only when [member occlusion] is enabled.

Controls how material transmission is applied when [member occlusion] is enabled. Frequency-Independent uses one broadband attenuation value; Frequency-Dependent preserves separate low, middle, and high frequency transmission.
